Our little big idea

More than a drink.
A taste of home.

Pahadi Fizz celebrates the flavours that make our corner of the Himalayas feel special. We’re building a local beverage brand around familiar desi notes, a curious new twist and a simple promise: make every little break feel brighter.

Born as a concept in Uttarakhand. Made for everyday moments, roadside stops, lunch breaks and long conversations.
